title: Let the body learn surrender first
summary: This meets the self that admires devotion while still bargaining with it. The line is physical and uncompromising: the body itself is given to the Guru.
takeaway: Let surrender become embodied, not admired.
lifeApplication: Before image management starts again, bow the head and shoulders physically. Let the body tell the truth before the mind edits it.

source.shortMeaning: Devotion becomes real when the body enters surrender.
source.lifeApplication: When ego starts negotiating, bow physically before you let it speak.

evidence.coreClaim: Devotion becomes real when the body enters surrender.
evidence.turn: Let surrender reach the body before the ego performs again.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before image management starts again, bow the head and shoulders physically. Let the body tell the truth before the mind edits it.
